column1: # *** THE 1812 PADRON, READ FROM THE IMAGE AT LAST - 20 September 2026. ***
# Row 30 asked for this because the archive had only ever quoted a published transcription
# of AGN, Fondo ex AGA, L 251. *** The page is on FamilySearch after all *** - in a collection
# nobody here had opened: *** Uruguay, Census Records, 1726-1858. ***
# *** The page carries the AGN Montevideo stamp and is captioned, by the filmers,
# 'Paginas Rotas / Escritura poco Legible' - torn pages, barely legible writing. ***

column2: Index ark *** 1:1:61LW-R54J *** ('Sancho Llerena, masculino, 45, Andaluzia'); image ark *** 3:1:3QS7-99ZR-NKNR ***; apid *** TH-1951-36766-17605-18 ***; dist.jpg is *** 3793 x 2909. ***
column3: *** CERTAIN, and it retires the row's premise: *** the archive assumed this document could only be read at the AGN in Montevideo. *** It could have been read from a desk at any point. *** The index even carries 'Andaluzia', which is the transcription's 'andaluz' in the register's own hand.

column1: *** SANCHO'S HOUSEHOLD, AS THE PAGE HAS IT ***
column2: Under one bracket, in order: *** SANCHO LLERENA / MARIA FERNANDEZ su esposa / JUAN AGUSTIN / PEDRO ANTº / FIDEL / LUIS / AGUSTINA. ***
column3: *** CERTAIN. *** Seven names, and they match the transcription this archive has been quoting for weeks - *** the six children 'naturales del Canelon' are all there and in that order. *** The transcription was good.

column1: *** AND DIRECTLY ABOVE, UNDER HOUSEHOLD NUMBER 59, FOUR NAMED PEOPLE ***
column2: *** JUANA - 41 *** ; *** JUAN, 'negro esclavo' *** ; *** GABRIEL *** ; *** MARIA. *** The margin reads *** '59.' *** against Juana, and Sancho's bracket begins on the line below Maria.
column3: *** THE NAMES ARE LEGIBLE. WHOSE HOUSEHOLD THEY BELONG TO IS NOT. *** The bracket that holds them is distinct from Sancho's, and the family above them is a *** 'Sargento Veterano de Caballeria' *** with a wife *** Sabina Balmaceda. *** *** So these four may belong to that household, or to Sancho's, and this page at this resolution does not say. ***

column1: *** WHY THAT MATTERS MORE THAN IT LOOKS ***
column2: This archive states, in data and on its pages, that *** 'the 1812 padron records four enslaved people in Sancho's household at calle San Juan No 60 and gives none of them a name'. ***
column3: *** THAT STATEMENT NOW NEEDS RE-EXAMINING. *** Four people are named immediately beside Sancho, one of them marked *** 'negro esclavo' ***, and the first of them is *** JUANA, aged 41. *** *** The baptism act of 26 September 1812 names JUANA as an enslaved woman of Don Sancho Lerena and Dona Maria Fernandez, mother of Maria Mercedes born two days earlier. *** *** A Juana of 41 standing at the edge of his household in the same year is a convergence this archive cannot ignore and must not yet assert. ***

*** The bracket, read at higher magnification than dist.jpg allows, or the household numbering read across the whole opening. *** The filmers' own caption warns the writing is poor. *** Until then: four names recorded, attribution open, and the archive's 'gives none of them a name' flagged rather than quietly overwritten. ***

column1: *** RESOLVED, AND THE ARCHIVE'S OWN STATEMENT IS WRONG ***
column2: The household was read to its end. In order under one bracket: *** SANCHO LLERENA / MARIA FERNANDEZ / JUAN AGUSTIN / PEDRO ANTº / ... / AGUSTINA / JUSTA / DOMINGA / ANTONIO 'negro esclavo' / JOSE / JUANA / TERESA / RODRIGO FERNANDEZ *** - and the next bracket opens at a *** Teresa Castro ***, which closes it.
column3: *** THE FOUR ENSLAVED PEOPLE ARE NAMED: ANTONIO, JOSE, JUANA AND TERESA. *** This archive has said, in its data and on its pages, that the padron *** 'gives none of them a name'. *** It names all four. *** RODRIGO FERNANDEZ closing the household is the proof the boundary is right *** - the transcription puts him in it, at 63, asturiano, and he is the last name before the next bracket. *** AND JUANA IS THERE, INSIDE SANCHO'S HOUSEHOLD *** - the same Juana the baptism act of 26 September 1812 calls an enslaved woman of Don Sancho Lerena and Dona Maria Fernandez, mother of Maria Mercedes. *** Two independent documents, the same year, the same household. ***

column1: *** AND I FLAGGED THE WRONG FOUR FIRST ***
column2: Earlier today this file and /hypotheses/ pointed at *** Juana 41, Juan 'negro esclavo', Gabriel and Maria *** - the four standing ABOVE Sancho under margin number 59 - and called that Juana a convergence.
column3: *** THAT WAS THE WRONG HOUSEHOLD, and the mistake was reading upward instead of downward. *** Those four are house 59, a different address. *** Sancho's four are BELOW his six children, and the tell was Dominga: *** the transcription ends the children at Dominga, and everything after her to Rodrigo Fernandez is the rest of his household. *** The 41-year-old Juana of house 59 is a different woman from Sancho's Juana. *** Corrected here rather than quietly rewritten, because the first reading was published for an hour.
